name: North Yanshi Outpost
title: North Yanshi Outpost
summary: A starter outpost on a small hilltop north-east of Yanshi: the spire-roofed outpost house with a lantern, a 28 m Empyrean tower with green crown lights, Life Stones with their sign and a stone hall with pillars. At the hill's western foot (240 m) a ring of fifteen settlement portals stands in the grass.
